description: This Java class is responsible for loading and parsing an XML ECU definition file into a DOM Document object. It provides a static method to perform this operation given an EcuDefinition instance which supplies the XML file.

classes.name: EcuDefinitionDocumentLoader
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to load an XML ECU definition file into a DOM Document.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Reads an ECU definition XML file from the EcuDefinition object and parses it into a DOM Document object.
